question: ip-proxy/proxyscrape-free-list and ip-proxy/openproxylist-xyz carry verdict dead on the strength of a low share of lines that carry a payload (32 of 100 and 12 of 60 sampled on 2026-10-24), while the vocabulary defines dead as the offer or the service no longer exists. Is each list still served, and if so should its verdict follow ip-proxy/thespeedx-proxy-list, which this unit moves from dead to qualifies-with-caveat?
why: ip-proxy/thespeedx-proxy-list answered on 2026-11-02 with a public repository that is not archived and was pushed that day (the GitHub API resource and the three latest commits titled Updated Proxies), so dead did not describe it; its yield stays recorded as the named limit (8 of 100 lines carried a payload). ip-proxy/monosans-proxy-list, a live list with 35 of 100 lines carrying a payload, already carries qualifies-with-caveat, so the sibling lists disagree on one basis.
